tips_en: Start with the AREX paper (Paper 1), as its novel 'discovery–verification asymmetry' framework and recursive self-improvement design offer a conceptually rigorous blueprint for building more capable LLM agents. It pairs naturally with the VCSD paper (Paper 3), which also exploits an asymmetry signal—purely visual input conditioning—to improve vision-language models without external supervision. Together, both papers highlight a broader theme: cleverly constructed asymmetries can drive self-improvement, while the K12-KGraph work (Paper 2) complements them by showing how structured, curriculum-aligned knowledge can serve as a rich supervision signal for training and benchmarking educational AI.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读AREX论文（论文1），其提出的"发现-验证不对称性"框架和递归自我改进机制为构建更强大的LLM智能体提供了严谨的思路。它与VCSD论文（论文3）形成了有趣的呼应——后者同样利用"不对称性"信号（纯视觉输入条件）来提升视觉语言模型。二者共同揭示了一个更广泛的主题：巧妙构建的不对称性可以驱动模型的自我改进。K12-KGraph论文（论文2）则从结构化、课程对齐的知识图谱角度，为训练和评测教育AI提供了高质量的监督信号，与前两篇互为补充。
